records.programming_guardrails: Age-appropriate instruction, qualified supervision, technique, enjoyment, gradual loading; avoid adult bodybuilding assumptions.
records.escalation: Parent/guardian and qualified youth coach; medical input for health concerns. [S08]

records.programming_guardrails: Individualise around function, balance, comorbidities and experience; progressive resistance training supports strength and independence.
records.escalation: Clinical review when symptoms, unstable conditions or significant limitations exist. [S07]

records.programming_guardrails: Exercise is generally encouraged in uncomplicated pregnancy with individual modifications; clinical assessment is important.
records.escalation: Obstetric provider for complications or warning signs such as bleeding, fluid leakage, chest pain, dizziness or calf swelling. [S06]

records.programming_guardrails: Return gradually when medically safe; delivery mode, healing, pelvic-floor symptoms and complications matter.
records.escalation: Obstetric/physio assessment for pain, incontinence, heaviness, bleeding or other concerning symptoms. [S06]

records.programming_guardrails: Ask what the person can do comfortably; adapt position, equipment, range and access; never assume inability.
records.escalation: Specialist clinician / adaptive exercise professional as needed.

records.programming_guardrails: Do not infer safe intensity from condition name alone; ask whether clinician has given exercise guidance.
records.escalation: Refer to treating clinician; no diagnosis or medication advice.

records.programming_guardrails: General fitness advice only; respect clinician restrictions and pain response.
records.escalation: Rehabilitation plan belongs to qualified healthcare professional.
